exit 0
--- stdout
Mark an agent as degraded for role-capacity health.
This records diagnostic health separate from agent lifecycle status and task
state. repair-agent-pool ignores current degraded agent epochs when computing
effective capacity.
Usage:
liza mark-agent-degraded <agent-id> [flags]
Flags:
--candidate-task strings candidate task considered during the degraded signal
--error string last observed error
-h, --help help for mark-agent-degraded
--reason string structured degraded reason
--recover-hint string operator recovery hint
--role string runtime role whose capacity is degraded
--task string last task associated with the degraded signal
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
